question.problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $V,$ given by

$$
V=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 2 \\ 4 & 3 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & -1 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the following row operations on $V?$

$$
\begin{aligned}{R}_{2} & ↔{R}_{3} \\ {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{1}\end{aligned}
$$
question.html:
6.Applying Row Operations To an Augmented Matrix?

Consider the augmented matrix V, given by V=[100243211−103]. What matrix results from carrying out the following row operations on V?

R2↔R3R2:=R2+(−1)⋅R1

question.worked_solution:
Let's list the required operations:

- The operation ${R}_{2}↔{R}_{3}$ means that we need to swap the second and third rows.

- The operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{1}$ means that we need to add $-1$ times the first row to the second row.

Applying the operations, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}V & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 2 \\ 4 & 3 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & -1 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]\,{R}_{2}↔{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & -1 & 0 & 3 \\ 4 & 3 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}]\,{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 2 \\ 1+(-1)(1) & -1+(-1)(0) & 0+(-1)(0) & 3+(-1)(2) \\ 4 & 3 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 & 1 \\ 4 & 3 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
